user.title: IntegrationGuard
user.description: A GitHub token is optional. Without one, GitHub allows 60 requests per hour, which is enough for a daily check but slow on the first run. With a token it is 5000 per hour.

data_description.github_token: A personal access token with read access to public repositories. Leave empty to work without one.
Leave empty to work without a token.

scan.name: Scan now
scan.description: Checks every installed repository right away instead of waiting for the schedule.

force.name: Force
force.description: Refresh every repository from GitHub, even those checked recently. The hourly rate limit still applies.

ignore.name: Ignore repository
ignore.description: Stops reporting about one repository, optionally only for a while.

repository.name: Repository
repository.description: The identifier from the panel: owner/repo, or app:slug for an app.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Ignore only for this long. Leave empty to ignore indefinitely.
